subject: QBR headcount consensus: capacity & backfill asks
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightline Talent <talent@brightline.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: QBR headcount consensus: capacity & backfill asks

Team — attaching the QBR headcount packet for the leadership checkpoint (see attached workbook + org chart). High level asks we need alignment on before Friday: 

1) Backfills: 4 IC backfills across Serving Runtime (2), Console (1), and Customer Reliability (1) — hires to be posted immediately.
2) New reqs: 2 hires for Model Ops (senior infra engineer + deploy engineer) to support Dedicated growth.
3) Contractor conversions: 3 contractors are up for conversion; proposed hold on one (contractor #112) pending budget carveout.
4) Re-allocation: propose moving one open compensation bucket from Research to Platform to accelerate infra hire.

Ask: please review the attached tab "ACTIONS" and reply with Approve / Defer / Reject + short rationale by EOD Wed (11/03). If we hit consensus we will route the approved reqs to People Ops for posting and notify Brightline for immediate sourcing.

Notes: QBR goal—ensure we have predictable capacity for Dedicated and the upcoming holiday season. Projections and cost model in workbook.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Talent Planning & Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: qbr_headcount_proposal_q4.xlsx (spreadsheet), org_chart_v2.pdf (chart)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR headcount consensus: capacity & backfill asks

Tessa — thanks for the packet. Quick thoughts:

- Backfills for Serving Runtime (2): Approve. Those two are blocking our throughput objectives for Q4.
- Console (1): Approve, but prefer hiring L4 over L3 given scope.
- Customer Reliability (1): Defer. We should re-evaluate the role after the support tooling rollout (end of Nov).
- Contractor conversions: Approve conversions for contractors #213 and #219; hold contractor #112 as proposed.

If People Ops needs final signoff, I'm happy to take the lead on the Customer Reliability decision once we have the rollout metrics.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: QBR headcount consensus: capacity & backfill asks

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 11:17 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Tessa — thanks for the packet. Quick thoughts:
> 
> - Backfills for Serving Runtime (2): Approve.

Agree on serving hires — those are high impact. A couple of additional recommendations: 

- Prioritize infra (Model Ops infra) hire over the second new req for Deploy — we can temporarily reassign an existing senior embed engineer to handle deploy integration for 6–8 weeks. This reduces near-term risk to Dedicated launch.
- For the Console hire, consider a hybrid L3/L4 job posting that allows us to ladder once we find senior candidates.

Linking the modeling of shifted budget here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBR-Headcount-Proposal (see tab "Budget Shift - infra first").

Soojin Lee
Head of Platform Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: QBR headcount consensus: capacity & backfill asks

Thanks — I approve the backfills and the infra-first prioritization. One minor ask: if we approve both new reqs today, please cap total external agency spend to the QBR budget line (<= $35k) and route vendor invoices through Procurement (cc ops@acme.com).

If People Ops needs a single consolidated decision, mark me as Approve for everything except Customer Reliability (Defer).

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightline Talent <talent@brightline.com>, ops@acme.com
Date: Thu, 04 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: QBR headcount consensus & next steps

Team — summary of consensus and next steps based on replies: 

Consensus:
- Approve: 3 backfills (Serving Runtime x2, Console x1 as L3->L4 ladder).
- Defer: Customer Reliability backfill pending support tooling rollout metrics.
- Approve: 1 infra Model Ops hire (priority). Defer the second deploy req; we will re-evaluate after the 6–8 week internal reassign.
- Contractor conversions: approve #213 and #219; hold #112.
- Budget: cap agency spend to <= $35k; route invoices to ops@acme.com.

Next steps:
- I will send an approved req packet to People Ops and CC Brightline to start sourcing for the approved roles by Monday (11/08).
- Laura to own Customer Reliability go/no-go post-rollout (target 11/30).
- Soojin & Markus to coordinate the temporary reassign and confirm expected timeline (Soojin to share handoff doc).

Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1QBR-Headcount-Proposal

Thanks all — I'll turn this into the formal decision memo and route to People Ops and Procurement.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Talent Planning & Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: qbr_headcount_proposal_q4.xlsx, org_chart_v2.pdf
